fixed_sql_evidence.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS baseline_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS baseline_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS target_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS target_sales FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01')

SELECT p.product_category_name AS dimension_key, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN o.order_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS change_value FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE ((o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01')) GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN o.order_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN o.order_id END) < 0 ORDER BY change_value, p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT i.seller_id AS dimension_key, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN o.order_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS change_value FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE ((o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01')) AND p.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho' GROUP BY i.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') THEN o.order_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01') THEN o.order_id END) < 0 ORDER BY change_value, i.seller_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS baseline_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS baseline_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS target_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS target_sales FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01')

SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) < 0 ORDER BY delta_brl, p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT i.seller_id AS dimension_key, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS change_value FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE ((o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01')) AND p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' GROUP BY i.seller_id HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) < 0 ORDER BY change_value, i.seller_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS baseline_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS baseline_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS target_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS target_sales FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01')
